assertions.name: sdp_c_2_extraction_disagrees_with_proved_canonical
assertions.source: Audit invariant: the SDP-extracted c_2 differs from the proved canonical c_2 = -1 by more than 0.1% (actual: ~1.7%). Confirms the extraction methodology carries a systematic bias even on the proved canonical rung.

description: Audits the canonical SDP c_k extraction in qbeta-decay-sdp-extended-ck.witness.json against the proved canonical c_2 = -1. Reports the bias on c_2 (proved vs extracted) and the implied contamination of the residue-A precision-ceiling computation. Tests whether the 'extract more rungs' unblock path is the right diagnosis.

data.verdict: The SDP-extracted c_2 differs from the proved canonical -1 by +1.7%. This is a systematic bias in the SDP extraction methodology, present even on the proved-canonical rung. The precision-ceiling diagnosis ('need more rungs') is correct in principle but misses this bias: more rungs from the SAME biased methodology won't reduce the asymptote's intrinsic spread. The genuine unblock path is closed-form per-rung derivation (matching proved c_2 = -1) or fibre-level Habiro (per PR #1811 + ck-dk registry §3).
